components.name: go2_readonly_telemetry
health_command: import json,time,pathlib; s=json.loads(pathlib.Path('.runtime/go2/telemetry.json').read_text()); assert s['ready'] and s['read_only'] and not s['synthetic'] and not s['motion_api_imported']; assert s['boot_id']==pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(); assert all(0<=(time.monotonic_ns()-s[k])/1e9<.3 for k in ['sport_received_monotonic_ns','lowstate_received_monotonic_ns']); print('Live read-only Go2 feedback')

components.name: go2_readonly_camera
health_command: import json,time,pathlib,urllib.request; c=json.loads(pathlib.Path('.runtime/go2/camera.json').read_text()); assert c['ready'] and 0<=(time.time_ns()-c['timestamp_ns'])/1e9<1; s=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8093/status',timeout=2)); r=s['sensors']['rgb']; assert r and 0<=r['age_s']<1 and not r['synthetic'] and r['timestamp_source']=='go2_video_rpc_receive_host_system_time_not_sensor_source_time'; print('Live native RGB; receive-time proxy, exposure time unavailable')

components.name: ros_observer
health_command: import json,urllib.request; s=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8093/status',timeout=2)); assert all(s['sensors'][k] and 0<=s['sensors'][k]['age_s']<1 for k in ['rgb','odom']); assert not s['execution_capability']['operator_run_configured']; print('Native RGB + measured odom; no aligned depth, shadow only')
